findings.summary: Credential files were not included in every canonical destination-separation check.
findings.failure_scenario: An output aliases the provider or receipt key after the initial CLI check.
findings.impact: Artifact publication could overwrite credential material.
findings.minimum_fix: Carry credential paths through every pre-effect and pre-publication canonical-path check.

findings.summary: An interruption between repository-head and external-anchor publication lacked a durable recovery record.
findings.failure_scenario: The process exits after publishing only part of a receipt transaction.
findings.impact: A valid chain could become unavailable or an unanchored entry could obstruct a lawful retry.
findings.minimum_fix: Publish an authenticated pending-head journal before the entry and recover deterministically before collision checks.

findings.summary: The evaluator transport requires structured output but capability preflight did not require it for every model.
findings.failure_scenario: A baseline or candidate lacks structured output while the transport still sends response_format.
findings.impact: Provider work could begin for an incompatible model.
findings.minimum_fix: Require text generation and structured output for baseline and candidate before transport.

residual_risks: Live provider behavior is not exercised in offline CI.
Recommendation authorization composition remains a V1-07 concern.

state_impact: Canonical path separation protects outputs, credentials, receipt state, and the external anchor.
The authenticated journal makes receipt publication recoverable without accepting unanchored state.
source_of_truth_changes: None; the repair protects existing trust-state boundaries.
feedback_plan: GitHub CI replays the complete offline suite after push.
blast_radius: CLI evaluation output and receipt publication
rollback_or_deletion_test: Tests cover interrupted publication before the immutable entry and safe same-record retry.
systems_questions.system_model_summary: Evaluation side effects begin only after compatible models and separated destinations are established; receipt publication is recoverable and externally anchored.
